shifa_pain_in_body.title: When Feeling Pain in the Body
shifa_pain_in_body.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (٣ مَرَّاتٍ)، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (٧ مَرَّاتٍ)
shifa_pain_in_body.transliteration: Bismillāh (3x). A'ūdhu billāhi wa qudratihī min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir (7x).
shifa_pain_in_body.translation: Place your hand on the area of pain, say 'Bismillah' three times, then say seven times: 'I seek refuge in Allah and in His power from the evil of what I find and of what I fear.'
shifa_pain_in_body.benefit: Uthman ibn Abi al-As reported that he complained of pain to the Prophet (ﷺ), who taught him this remedy. He said: 'I did that and Allah removed my suffering.'
shifa_pain_in_body.occasion: Place your right hand on the painful area, say Bismillah 3 times, then tap the counter to recite the supplication 7 times.

shifa_visiting_sick_1.title: Visiting the Sick (No Harm, Purification)
shifa_visiting_sick_1.arabicText: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
shifa_visiting_sick_1.transliteration: Lā ba'sa, ṭahūrun in shā' Allāh.
shifa_visiting_sick_1.translation: Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification (from sins), if Allah wills.
shifa_visiting_sick_1.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) would say this whenever he visited an ill person, giving them solace and hope of forgiveness.
shifa_visiting_sick_1.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari with Al-Fath 10/118 | Hisnul Muslim 147
shifa_visiting_sick_1.occasion: Recite when visiting or speaking with someone who is ill.

shifa_visiting_sick_2.title: Supplication for Recovery (Recite 7 Times)
shifa_visiting_sick_2.arabicText: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ، رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
shifa_visiting_sick_2.translation: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you. (Recited 7 times)
shifa_visiting_sick_2.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever visits a sick person whose appointed time of death has not yet arrived, and recites this seven times, Allah will surely cure him of that illness.'
shifa_visiting_sick_2.reference: At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud; Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/210 | Hisnul Muslim 148
shifa_visiting_sick_2.occasion: Recite 7 times beside an ill person.

shifa_calamity.title: When Afflicted by Tragedy or Loss
shifa_calamity.arabicText: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
shifa_calamity.transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji'ūn, Allāhumma'-jurnī fī muṣībatī, wa akhlif lī khayran minhā.
shifa_calamity.translation: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
shifa_calamity.benefit: Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) recited this after Abu Salamah died, and Allah gave her the best of husbands, the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).
shifa_calamity.occasion: Recite immediately upon hearing bad news, suffering a loss, or experiencing any tragedy.
